page_data.en:
Parag. 38. Formation of a new "Korean Residents' Association
in Shanghai" (pro-Japanese).

We are informed that during the course of a meeting
of members of the "Korean Society" at the Japanese Y.M.C.A.
held on March 3, it was decided to dissolve this body and
to create in its place a "Korean Residents' Association in
Shanghai."

Thus, as we have pointed out this transformation
seems to correspond to the intention of the new organisation
of taking under its control all Korean residents in Shanghai.

Mr. LI CHIA MING (李甲寧) was elected President
of the new Association. At present he is working at the local
Japanese Consulate-General. He received his education at the
Agricultural Faculty of the Imperial University, Tokio, and
is reported to have played an important role among journalists.

第38段。成立新的“上海朝鲜人居住者协会”（亲日）。

据悉，在3月3日于日本青年会举行的“朝鲜人协会”成员会议期间，决定解散该团体，并取而代之成立“上海朝鲜人居住者协会”。

因此，正如我们所指出的，这一转变似乎符合新组织意图控制所有在上海的朝鲜居民的目的。

李甲寧先生当选为新协会的主席。他目前在日本驻上海总领事馆工作。他曾就读于东京帝国大学农学部，据报在记者界扮演重要角色。

March 6, 1938.    Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

NIPPI

MEETING OF JAPANESE CONSULS-GENERAL TO BE HELD
IN SHANGHAI

A Jentsu telegram from
Tokyo dated March 4 reports that Foreign Minister
Hirota has ordered Mr. Yokotake, Commercial Attache
in Shanghai, to return to Tokyo and also decided to
call back Mr. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister to China,
in order to obtain information regarding the present
situation in China. As soon as the preparations for
Sino-Japanese co-operation have been completed a meeting
of Japanese Consuls-General will be called at Shanghai
to discuss detailed plans of action. Consuls-General
Ishii of Shanghai, Suma of Nanking, Mizusawa of Hongkong,
Kawakoshi of Tientsin, Kawai of Canton, Sakane of Tsingtao,
Nishida of Tsinan, Miura of Hankow and Usami of Foochow
will together with several others attend the meeting.
At the meeting the policy of Japanese government regard-
ing China will be explained in detail so that the
various diplomats may act efficiently in the matter.
Mr. Sugihara, Consul at
Shanghai, has informed a representative of this paper
that it would be possible to hold a meeting of the
Consuls-General but that he had so far received no
instructions or information from the Home office.

KOREAN RESIDENTS ASSOCIATION ORGANIZED

A general meeting of the
local Korean Society was held at the Japanese Y.M.C.A.
at 7 p.m. March 3, at which the society was dissolved
and the Korean Residents Association formed. Mr.
Li Kab Nung, employed on the staff of Tokyo Foreign
Office, was elected as the chairman of the Association.

NICHI-NICHI

TWO JAPANESE ATTEMPT SUICIDE

At 8 a.m. March 3 a Japanese
named S. Yasuda residing on Woosung Road swallowed a
quantity of poisonous drug in an attempt to end his
life. Dr. Sudo attended him but he died of the poison.
The motive behind his action is reported as being due
to family trouble.
At 10 p.m. March 3 another
Japanese named M. Nunoi, age 27, an employee of the
Fujiyama Yoko on Siking Road, was found suffering from
poisoning and was removed to the Foc Ming Hospital.
His life is now out of danger although his condition
is still serious. The reason of his action is
reported to be an unsuccessful love affair.

杂项

《日日新闻》

日本驻各地总领事将在上海举行会议

东京3月4日电讯报道，外相广田已命令驻上海商务参赞横竹先生返回东京，并决定召回日本驻华公使有吉先生，以获取关于中国当前局势的信息。一旦中日合作的准备工作完成，将在上海召开日本总领事会议，讨论详细的行动计划。上海的石井、南京的须磨、香港的水泽、天津的川越、广州的河合、青岛的坂根、济南的西田、汉口的三浦和福州的宇佐美等总领事将与其他几人一同出席会议。会议上将详细解释日本政府 regarding 中国的政策，以便各位外交官在此事项上有效行动。
驻上海领事杉原先生告知本报代表，虽然有可能举行总领事会议，但他迄今未收到来自国内政府的任何指示或信息。

朝鲜人居住者协会成立

3月3日晚7时，当地朝鲜人协会在日本青年会举行全体会议，会上解散了该协会，并成立了朝鲜人居住者协会。任职于东京外务省的李甲宁先生当选为协会主席。

《日日新闻》

两名日本人企图自杀

3月3日上午8时，居住在吴淞路的一名日本人S. Yasuda吞服大量毒药企图结束生命。须藤医生对其进行了救治，但他仍因中毒身亡。据报道，其行动动机是家庭纠纷。
3月3日晚10时，另一名27岁的日本人M. Nunoi，系西京路富士山洋行雇员，被发现中毒，并被送往福明医院。虽然其状况仍然严重，但目前已脱离生命危险。据报道，其行动原因是一次失败的爱情经历。

Ri Mei Gyoku, alias Ri Ko Fuku, Korean radical, who was arrested on March 26, 1935, by the Japanese Consular Police in conjunction with the French Police on suspision of having been concerned in the assassination of Ri Yo Ro(李堯魯), a Korean, was sent Korea on board the s.s. "Heian Maru" to be dealt with by the Korean Police Authorities in accordance with law. The vessel left Shanghai for Jinsen on June 16.

The following information has been received from the local Japanese Consular Police regarding the antecedents of Ri Mei Gyoku:-

Ri Mei Gyoku was born in 1896 in Kokaido, Korea and he received his education in a private school in his native place from 1902 to 1916. In May, 1920, he was temporarily employed by the Koken(好賢) village office as a clerk. One month prior to this, he had become aquainted with a Korean named Tei Ki Do(丁熙道), through whose persuasion he joined the Korean independence movement and became an agent of the Korean Provisional Government in Shanghai. Whilst he was employed in the Koken village office, he distributed some 200 pamphlets, the contents of which aimed the instigation of a strike, among Korean officers. After which he devoted himself to collecting funds and obtaining members for the provisional government. Following the arrest of Tei Ki Do in August, 1920, Ri Mei Gyoku escaped into Manchuria, where he wandered from place to place until the end of 1921 and he arrived in Shanghai in February, 1922, with the object of joining the provisional government. 李梅玉（音译），别名李高福（音译），朝鲜激进分子，因涉嫌参与1935年3月刺杀朝鲜人李堯魯一案，于1935年3月26日被日本领事警察会同法国警察逮捕，随后由“平安丸”号轮船送往朝鲜，交由朝鲜警方依法处理。该船于6月16日离开上海前往仁川。

以下是从当地日本领事警察处获得的关于李梅玉背景的信息：

李梅玉于1896年出生在朝鲜咸镜道，1902年至1916年间在家乡的一所私立学校接受教育。1920年5月，他被好贤村公所临时聘为书记员。在此之前一个月，他结识了一位名叫丁熙道（音译）的朝鲜人，在其劝说下加入了朝鲜独立运动，并成为上海朝鲜临时政府的代理人。在好贤村公所任职期间，他在朝鲜官员中分发了约200份旨在煽动罢工的小册子。此后，他致力于为临时政府筹集资金和招募成员。1920年8月丁熙道被捕后，李梅玉逃往满洲，在那里四处流浪直到1921年底，并于1922年2月抵达上海，目的是加入临时政府。抵达上海后，他立即拜访了当时住在霞飞路宝康里的朝鲜侨民协会主席梁憲。在这次会面中，他

Antecedents of Gen Shun Ho(蒙順奎) alias Gen
Kyo Shun(蒙教順) alias Gen Jun Ho(蒙俊奎),
Assassin of Ki Yo Ho(金九).

Born in Keishohokudo, Korea, in 1905. Studied
Chinese for only four months in a private school in
his native place. In December 1923 he proceeded to
Manchuria and was employed as a farmer on a farm
owned by Hwa Shing Co.(華盛公司) in Feng Tao Prefecture
(奉天省), Sinkiang Province but he left this farm
in September 1926. Having obtained a letter of
introduction to a Korean named Ki Li Kyoku(奇利局),
a student in Peiping, from a certain doctor Hung(洪)
at Chu Ho Mission(朱河Mission), he proceeded to Peiping
at the end of November 1931 and interviewed Ki Mei
Kyoku, who introduced him to a Korean instructor
named Ryu Shi Mei of Lih Dah (立達) Agricultural
School at Nanziang(南翔). He arrived in
Shanghai on board the Chinese steamer "Tungchow"
at the beginning of December 1931 and stayed at
Tai An Lodging House(泰安旅館), Rue du Consulate.
Four days after arrival at Shanghai, he was visited
by Ryu Shi Mei at the lodging house and was taken
by him to an upstairs room in a Chinese tailor's
shop on Rue Cassini, which was the residence of Haku
Kyu Ha(白雲波), Den Ri Ho(田理芳), Gen Shin Sho
(元心昌), Ri Tatsu(李達) and Yo Jyo Shu(楊汝舟),
five Korean anarchists. These Koreans were members
of the South China Korean Youth League and of the
Black Terrorist Party. Whilst staying at this
address he became a member of the aforementioned
two organizations. Several months later he removed
to the dormitory of the Lih Dah Agricultural
School at Nanziang. At the beginning of December
1932 he again removed to No. 17 Ziang Jiu Li(祥樹里),
Rue de Marche on orders from Ryu Shi Mei and lived
with Ri Tatsu(李達), a prominent member of the

Ri Kei Ko was born in 1914 at Tung Hwa ( 通化 ),
Sing King Province, Manchuria, third son of Ri Kai
Li ( 李会榮 ), prominent Korean anarchist. Returned
to Korea in 1917 and stayed at Keijo until 1919,
when he proceeded to Peiping to live with his father.
During the period from 1923 to 1925 he studied at a
Chinese primary school in Peiping and later at the
Nankai Middle School in Tientsin. In September
1928 he came to Shanghai with his father for the
purpose of obtaining employment when he resided at
No. 42 Ai Lung Li ( 愛仁里 ), Avenue Roch. He obtained
employment with a Chinese pharmacy on Hankow Road,
but owing to this firm closing down he proceeded to
Nanking, where he obtained employment in the Hwa
Shing Printing Co. in April, 1930. Shortly after
the Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai in 1932
he returned to Shanghai and resided at No.13 Chin
Chung Li ( 建中里 ), Avenue Joffre, with his father.
Following his father's departure to Manchuria in
November 1932, he removed to the residence of Gen
Shin Sho ( 元心昌 ) and Go Sei Min ( 吳世民 ), associates
of his father, at No. 16 Yoong Zung Li ( 榮仁里 ), Rue
du Marche. These persons were prominent members
of the South China Korean Youth League and the Black
Terrorist Party. Whilst staying at this address he
became a member of these radical organizations,
having been introduced by his two friends. Following
the arrest of Gen Shin Sho on a charge of attempted
murder of Mr. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister, in March,
1933, he removed to No. 42 Zao Fong Li ( 肇方里 ), West
Gate, together with Go Sei Min. Go Sei Min was
later employed as a teacher at a middle school in
Chienchow ( 泉州 ), Fukien Province, and left for
Chienchow in April to assume his office. In May 1933

李圭浩于1914年出生于满洲吉林省通化（Tung Hwa），系著名朝鲜无政府主义者李会荣（Ri Kai Li）的第三子。1917年返回朝鲜，在京城（Keijo）居住至1919年，随后前往北平与父亲同住。1923年至1925年间，他在北平的一所中国小学就读，后进入天津南开中学学习。1928年9月，他随父亲来到上海谋职，当时居住在霞飞路爱仁里42号。他在汉口路的一家华药房受雇，但因该店停业，他前往南京，于1930年4月在华兴印刷公司（Hwa Shing Printing Co.）获得职位。1932年上海中日战事爆发后不久，他返回上海，与父亲同住于霞飞路建中里13号。1932年11月其父前往满洲后，他搬至其父的同事元心昌（Gen Shin Sho）和吴世民（Go Sei Min）的住处，即菜市路荣仁里16号。此二人是华南朝鲜青年联盟和黑恐怖党的重要成员。在此期间，经这两位朋友介绍，他加入了这些激进组织。1933年3月，元心昌因涉嫌企图谋杀日本公使有吉明先生（Mr. Ariyoshi）被捕后，他与吴世民一同搬至西门肇方里42号。吴世民后来受聘为福建泉州一所中学的教师，并于4月前往泉州就职。1933年5月

May 22, 1935. Morning Translation.

MAINICHI

CHINESE DANCE HALL OWNER IN SHANGHAI FINANCING
BANDITS IN MANCHURIA

Bandits are still active in various parts of Manchuria. Most of them are receiving spiritual and material assistance from anti-Japanese and anti-Manchukuoan Chinese and a section of the Chinese authorities. The bandits under the leadership of Sun Young Chien, who had fled into Tsunghua Prefecture from the Southern part of Jehol, are being sheltered by the governor.

According to information received from certain reliable sources, a certain Chinese, who is the owner of a Chinese dance hall on North Szechuen Road, is reported to be one of the most important supporters of the bandits. He owns a great deal of real estate on Nanking Road and is an important figure in financial circles. He was the leader of the plain-clothes corps during the Shanghai incident. He and important Chinese merchants in Shanghai are sending money and arms to the bandits in Manchuria. With the help of about 10 Korean followers, he maintains communication between the bandits and the anti-Japanese groups in Shanghai. Some of the Koreans are reported to have received anti-Japanese education and regular military training from Chinese schools. They are now employed on the managing staff of the dance hall in question. Their activities are doing immense harm to Japan and Manchukuo. The indifferent attitude of the Nanking Government towards such Chinese authorities and people may endanger the relations between Japan and China and the peace of the Far East.

THE RECENT MURDERS OF LOCAL KOREANS

The examination by the Japanese Consular Police of the two Koreans named Aum Soon Bong, age 30, and Lee Kiou Ho, age 21, who murdered Lee Young Ro, the advisor to the Korean Residents Association, on March 25, 1935, reveals that the prisoners are members of the Korean anarchist party. They are also connected with the attempted murder of Mr. Ariyoshi in March 1933, the murder of K. B. Oak, manager of the A. C. K. Co. in August 1933 and the murder of S. B. Oak, an employee of the French Police in December 1933.

NICHI-NICHI

KOREAN ARRESTED FOR SELLING HEROIN

Acting on information from the S.M.P. the Japanese Consular Police on May 20 arrested a Korean named Dun Zui Sam, age 27, at No. 20 Chongtu Fong, Chongtu Road, for selling drugs to Chinese. A quantity of heroin was also seized. The prisoner is now being detained at the Japanese Consulate for examination.

1935年5月22日。晨间译稿。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

上海华人舞厅老板资助满洲匪徒

匪徒在满洲各地依然活跃。他们中的大多数人正从反日、反满洲国的中国人以及部分中国当局那里获得精神和物质援助。由孙永健（Sun Young Chien，音译）领导的匪帮从热河南部逃入通化府，正受到当地省长的庇护。

据某些可靠来源的情报显示，一名在北四川路拥有一家华人舞厅的中国人，据报道是匪徒最重要的支持者之一。他在南京路拥有大量房地产，是金融界的重要人物。在上海事变期间，他曾担任便衣队队长。他和上海的重要中国商人正在向满洲的匪徒输送资金和武器。在大约10名朝鲜追随者的帮助下，他维持着匪徒与上海反日团体之间的联络。据报道，部分朝鲜人曾在中国学校接受反日教育和正规军事训练。他们目前受雇于该舞厅的管理层。他们的活动对日本和满洲国造成了巨大危害。南京政府对此类中国当局和民众的漠视态度，可能会危及中日关系及远东和平。

近期当地朝鲜人被杀案

日本领事警察对两名朝鲜人安顺奉（Aum Soon Bong，30岁）和李基浩（Lee Kiou Ho，21岁）进行的审讯显示，这两人杀害了朝鲜居留民团顾问李扬罗（Lee Young Ro，音译，即前文之李扬）。审讯揭示，囚犯均为朝鲜无政府主义党派成员。他们还与1933年3月企图谋杀有吉明先生、1933年8月谋杀A.C.K.公司经理K. B. Oak以及1933年12月谋杀法国警察雇员S. B. Oak的案件有关联。

《日日新闻》（NICHI-NICHI）

朝鲜人因贩卖海洛因被捕

根据工部局警务处（S.M.P.）提供的情报，日本领事警察于5月20日在崇德路崇德坊20号逮捕了一名27岁的朝鲜人邓醉三（Dun Zui Sam，音译），罪名是向中国人出售毒品。现场还查获了大量海洛因。该囚犯目前被拘留在日本领事馆接受审讯。

April 26, 1935. Morning Translation.

NIPPO

A KOREAN SHOOTS FELLOW COUNTRYMAN IN FRENCH CONCESSION

A Korean named Kim E-yeu
Shu, residing at No. 200 Rue Porte de l'Ouest, French
Concession, was shot at by a fellow countryman at the
corner of Rue Porte de l'Ouest and Rue Brenier de
Montmorand at 9 p.m. April 24 and wounded in the left
shoulder.

A detective of the French
Police rushed to the scene but the assailant had already
made good his escape. The victim was immediately
removed to a hospital; his condition is not serious.
The injured man states that he cannot give a description
of his assailant but he was certain that the man was a
Korean.

Questioned about the shooting,
the Japanese Consular Police state that they had received
no information from the French authorities. The victim
is a Korean revolutionist whose activities were being
closely watched. The shooting was probably due to a
dispute among Korean revolutionists.

JAPANESE COMMITTED FOR TRIAL ON A CHARGE OF EMBEZZLEMENT

A Japanese named Y. Wata
age 38, was committed for trial by the Japanese Consular
Court yesterday on a charge of embezzlement.

CHIANG KAI SHEK SERIOUSLY ILL

On the night of April 24
information was received to the effect that Chiang Kai
Shek, who is now at Kweiyang, is seriously ill.
According to information
received by a certain party on April 25, an American
doctor at Chungking accompanied by several nurses,
proceeded to Kweiyang by aeroplane on April 22. This
shows that Chiang Kai Shek is seriously sick. Nothing
definite is known because the doctor has not yet returned.

GENERAL ISOGAE RETURNS TO SHANGHAI

Major-General Isogae, Military
Attache to the Japanese Legation, in company with Assistant
Military Attache Kagase, returned to Shanghai from Nanking
at 7 a.m. April 25.

ADMIRAL ARAKI TO ENTERTAIN JAPANESE RESIDENTS

Rear-admiral Araki, Commander
of the Japanese Landing Party, will entertain prominent
Japanese residents at the Landing Party Headquarters
from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. April 28.

1935年4月26日。晨间译稿。

《日报》（NIPPO）

法租界一朝鲜人枪击同胞

居住在法租界西江路200号的一名朝鲜人金义秀（Kim E-yeu Shu，音译），于4月24日晚9时在西江路与白莱尼蒙马浪路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）转角处被一名同胞枪击，左肩受伤。

法国警察的一名侦探迅速赶赴现场，但袭击者已逃脱。受害者立即被送往医院；伤势不重。伤者表示无法描述袭击者的外貌，但他确信此人是朝鲜人。

就此次枪击事件询问日本领事警察时，他们表示未从法国当局收到任何信息。受害者是一名朝鲜革命者，其活动一直受到严密监视。此次枪击可能是由于朝鲜革命者内部的纠纷所致。

日本人因挪用公款罪被交付审判

一名38岁的日本人Y. Wata（音译）昨日被日本领事法院以挪用公款罪交付审判。

蒋介石病重

4月24日晚收到消息，称目前在贵阳的蒋介石病重。
据某方于4月25日收到的消息，重庆的一名美国医生在几名护士的陪同下，于4月22日乘飞机前往贵阳。这表明蒋介石病情严重。由于医生尚未返回，具体情况尚不明确。

矶谷少将返回上海

日本公使馆武官矶谷（Isogae）少将与助理武官加濑（Kagase）一同，于4月25日上午7时从南京返回上海。

荒木海军少将宴请日本侨民

日本陆战队指挥官荒木（Araki）海军少将将于4月28日上午10时至下午3时，在陆战队总部宴请知名日本侨民。

（左侧手写批注：D6652，D6277）

April 23, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:-

THE ARREST OF A NATURALIZED CHINESE CITIZEN
OF KOREAN ORIGIN IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

In connection with the arrest by the French Police of Tsai Yin Sin (〔此处转录不清〕) alias Tsang Min Ngoh (〔此处转录不清〕), a naturalized Chinese citizen of Korean origin, lawyers Lau Yin Mei (〔此处转录不清〕) and Zee Ji (〔此处转录不清〕) have personally negotiated with the French Authorities but without result.

The lawyers sent a letter to the Chinese Bar Association stating that Tsai is under the protection of Chinese Law and should therefore be dealt with by a Chinese Court if he is guilty of any offence. At the same time, they also solicited assistance from the Association.

At a meeting held by the Chinese Bar Association the action of the French Police was regarded as an encroachment upon China's judicial rights and as a breach of the agreement concluded between the Chinese and French Authorities in connection with the establishment of a Chinese Court in the French Concession. On April 22 it sent a letter to the Shanghai City Government and the 2nd Special District Court requesting them to open negotiations with the French Authorities for the handing over of Tsai to a Chinese Court to be dealt with so that the judicial rights of China may be preserved and similar incidents may be averted.

The Eastern Daily News published the following article on April 19:-

TROTTING CLUB BEING SOLD TO JAPANESE

Some time ago, Loh Sih Hau (羅錫侯) established an International Trotting Club at Klangwan. Jockeys were engaged and horses were purchased from abroad. Owing to being heavily involved in connection with the failure of the China Industrial Bank, Loh did not carry out his scheme to the end.

Several months ago he repatriated the jockeys but kept the horses at Klangwan with the intention of making a new start after the case in connection with the China Industrial Bank had been brought to an end. As there seemed to be no prospect of the business being put through owing to the high cost of maintaining the horses, Loh determined to sell the horses. At this moment a Japanese who is planning the organization of a race-course approached Loh with an offer to purchase the horses and trotting vehicles from him.

It is now reported that Loh and the Japanese have reached an agreement, and a new race course will come into existence in the immediate future. Whether or not this race-course will retain the name of International Trotting Club is at present unknown.

《新晚报》及其他本地报纸：

法租界逮捕一名归化中国的朝鲜籍公民

关于法国警察逮捕归化中国的朝鲜籍公民蔡英信（Tsai Yin Sin，〔此处转录不清〕），又名张敏吾（Tsang Min Ngoh，〔此处转录不清〕）一事，律师刘寅梅（Lau Yin Mei，〔此处转录不清〕）和徐杰（Zee Ji，〔此处转录不清〕）已亲自与法国当局交涉，但未获结果。

律师们致函上海律师公会，指出蔡某受中国法律保护，因此若其有任何犯罪行为，应由中国法庭审理。同时，他们也请求公会提供协助。

在上海律师公会举行的会议上，法国警察的行动被视为对中国司法权的侵犯，并违反了中法当局关于在法租界设立中国法院所达成的协议。4月22日，公会致函上海市政府和第二特区地方法院，请求他们与法国当局交涉，将蔡某移交中国法庭处理，以维护中国的司法权并避免类似事件再次发生。

《东方日报》于4月19日刊登了以下文章：

跑马厅即将出售给日本人

此前，罗锡侯（Loh Sih Hau）在江湾建立了一个国际赛马会。他们聘请了骑师并从国外购买了马匹。由于与中国工业银行倒闭案牵连甚深，罗某未能将其计划贯彻到底。

几个月前，他遣返了骑师，但将马匹留在江湾，打算在中国工业银行案件结束后重新开始。由于饲养马匹成本高昂，业务似乎没有前景，罗某决定出售马匹。此时，一名正计划组建赛马场的日本人向罗某提出购买马匹和赛马车的要约。

现据报道，罗某与该日本人已达成协议，一个新的赛马场将在不久的将来成立。该赛马场是否会保留“国际赛马会”的名称，目前尚不清楚。

THE ARREST OF A NATURALIZED CHINESE SUBJECT

1936年4月22日。

逮捕一名归化中国籍民

1936年3月26日，归化中国的朝鲜籍民蔡英信（Tsai Yin Sin，崔英心），又名李明玉（Li in Agoh，李明玉），在法租界贝勒路协成里的住所被法国警察逮捕。随后他被移交给日本领事馆。他的归化证书在逮捕时被警方没收。

April 16, 1935.
Morning Translation: No. D - 4577

NIPPO

JAPANESE ARRESTED IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION BY
JAPANESE CONSULAR POLICE

On the night of April 14 a Japanese detective of the Japanese Consular Police arrested a Japanese named A. Jose, age 30, at the Central Auditorium, French Concession, on a charge of theft, and took him to the Japanese Consulate.
The man is alleged to have stolen a number of pocket watches valued at $478, seven wrist watches valued at $248 and 7 finger rings valued at $265 from a shop on Haining Road while he was in the employment of the shop.

DEPORTATION OF THREE KOREANS

It is reported that a Korean dancer named Owu Kyung Sun, age 28, residing at No. 9 Range Road will be deported to Korea by the Japanese Consular Police on April 16 on the S.S. Heian Maru because she has been in close touch with Korean revolutionists in the French Concession.
Another Korean named Song Bong Hak, age 23, an opium addict, and a third Korean named Kang Nam Sun, age 25, who are regarded as undesirable characters, will be deported to Korea by the Japanese authorities on the same steamer.

MAINICHI

FAMILY OF ASSASSINATED KOREAN LEAVING FOR HOLL LAND

The family of the late Lee Young Ro, adviser to the Korean Residents Association, who was assassinated on March 25 by Korean terrorists, will leave for Korea on April 16 on the S. S. Heian Maru.

RECRUITING OF JAPANESE TO JOIN THE SPECIAL POLICE

At the request of the Special Police of the S.M.C., the Japanese Street Unions are advising Japanese residents to join the Special Police. Applications may be sent either to the Street Unions or to the amalgamated association of Street Unions. Duty with the Special Police take places once a week from 8 p.m. to 10 p.m. Shooting practice will be held once every three months.

NICHI-NICHI

DEPARTURE OF JAPANESE CONSULS-GENERAL

Mr. Kani, Consul-General at Canton, and Mr. Tsukamoto, Consul-General at Amoy, will leave here at 10.30 a.m. to-day by the S.S. Chiserrka(?).

1935年4月16日。

《上海日报》（NIPPO）

日本领事警察在法租界逮捕一名日本人

4月14日晚，日本领事警察的一名侦探在法租界中央礼堂（Central Auditorium）以盗窃罪为由逮捕了一名30岁的日本人A. Jose（音译），并将其带往日本领事馆。
据称，该男子在受雇于海宁路一家商店期间，从该店窃取了价值478美元的若干怀表、价值248美元的七只手表以及价值265美元的七枚戒指。

驱逐三名朝鲜人

据报道，居住在兰路（Range Road）9号、28岁的朝鲜舞女Owu Kyung Sun（音译），因与法租界内的朝鲜革命者保持密切联系，将于4月16日由日本领事警察通过“平安丸”号（S.S. Heian Maru）轮船遣返回朝鲜。
另外两名被视为不良分子的朝鲜人——23岁的鸦片瘾君子Song Bong Hak（音译）和25岁的Kang Nam Sun（音译），也将由日本当局在同一艘轮船上遣返回朝鲜。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

被刺杀的朝鲜领袖家属将前往荷兰属地（Holl Land）

3月25日被朝鲜恐怖分子刺杀的朝鲜居留民团顾问李英鲁（Lee Young Ro）的家属，将于4月16日乘坐“平安丸”号（S. S. Heian Maru）轮船前往朝鲜。

招募日本人加入特别警察队

应工部局特别警察队的请求，日本各街道同乡会正在建议日本居民加入特别警察队。申请可递交至各街道同乡会或街道同乡会联合会。特别警察队的勤务时间为每周一次，从晚上8点至10点。射击训练每三个月举行一次。

《日日新闻》（NICHI-NICHI）

日本总领事离任

驻广州总领事加尼先生（Mr. Kani，音译）和驻厦门总领事塚本先生（Mr. Tsukamoto，音译）将于今天上午10:30乘坐“Chiserrka(?)”号轮船离开此地。

THE ARREST OF A KOREAN IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION.

In connection with the arrest by the French Police
of a korean named Tsai Ying Sing alias Lee Ming Nyoh, lawyers
Leu Yoong Mei and Zee Jih yesterday issued the following
circular addressed to the public :-
"According to Article 6 of the Agreement relating
to the establishment of a Chinese Court in the French
Concession of Shanghai, all persons arrested by the French
Police in the Concession are to be brought before a Court
within 24 hours of their arrest, holidays excepted, and if
they have not been brought before a Court at the expiry of
the time limit, they are to be released. Section I of
Article 7 of the said Agreement stipulates that no prisoner
shall be extradited without first being tried by a Court.
"On March 26 this year the French Police, for no
cause whatever, arrested at Yah Zung Lee, Rue Pere Froc, a
Korean named Tsai Ying Sing alias Lee Ming Nyoh who had
naturalised himself as a Chinese citizen on June 13, 1925.
At the time of his arrest, Tsai produced his naturalisation
papers which were seized by the Police.
"We were subsequently retained by Tsai's wife to
open negotiations with the French Authorities, but our
efforts have proved fruitless. On April 4 we received a
reply from Mr. Gabriel of the French Police stating that
Tsai had been handed over to the Japanese Consulate-General
in Shanghai on the day of his arrest. Later we called on
the French Consul-General who stated that he had no knowledge
of the case and promised to make an enquiry. We regret
that ten days have elapsed without a reply having been
received.
"As Tsai is a naturalised Chinese citizen, he
should be brought before the Shanghai Second Special District
Court for trial according to the Court Agreement, irrespective
of the fact as to whether he is guilty or innocent. The
French Police should not have arbitrarily arrested and
handed him over to the Japanese Authorities. Such an action
not only endangers the security of the residents of the
French Concession, but impairs China's sovereign rights.

就法国警察逮捕化名李明若（Lee Ming Nyoh）的朝鲜人蔡英星（Tsai Ying Sing）一事，律师刘永梅（Leu Yoong Mei，音译）和谢日（Zee Jih，音译）昨日发布了以下致公众的通函：
“根据《关于在上海法租界设立中国法院的协定》第六条，法国警察在租界内逮捕的所有人员，除节假日外，必须在逮捕后24小时内送交法庭审理，如果在规定期限届满时仍未送交法庭，则应予释放。该协定第七条第一款规定，任何囚犯未经法庭审判不得引渡。
“今年3月26日，法国警察毫无理由地在神父路（Rue Pere Froc）亚宗里（Yah Zung Lee，音译）逮捕了已于1925年6月13日归化为中国公民的朝鲜人蔡英星。被捕时，蔡出示了其归化证书，但被警察没收。

“由于蔡是归化的中国公民，无论他有罪与否，根据法院协定，都应将其送交上海第二特区地方法院受审。法国警察不应任意逮捕并将其移交给日本当局。这种行为不仅危及法租界居民的安全，而且损害了中国的主权权利。”

U.S. MARINE BLAMED FOR DEATH OF A CHINESE.

At 9.45 p.m. April 1 while a certain male Chinese, having the appearance of a labourer about 36 years of age, was walking from north to south on the side-walk near House No.138 on Route des Soeurs, French Concession, a heavily drunken American marine named "Mi-la-da Cos-ke"(密拉特司斯克), who was walking with a Russian female in the same direction and on the same side-walk as the Chinese, struck the Chinese on the face with his fist. The man fell to the ground unconscious, with blood flowing from his nose. After delivering a final kick at the man's buttocks, the marine walked away. The outrage was witnessed by Chinese Detective 364 Tsang Liang Un(張良恩) of the Political Section of the French Police, a waiter named Wong Ching Wu(王敬五) and Chinese watchman No.285 employed in an apartment house at No.134 Route des Soeurs. The three men raised an alarm and several policemen came up and took the American marine and the Russian female to the Lokawei Police Station. The injured man was removed to the Ste Marie Hospital where he died at 10.50 p.m. the same day without revealing his identity.
Yesterday morning an inquest was held by Procurator Wong Ning(王任) of the 2nd Special District Court. After hearing the evidence of the three witnesses, Procurator Wong returned a verdict of death due to injuries caused by the fall after being assaulted.
According to one witness, the accused stated to the Police that the deceased attempted to touch the breasts of the Russian female and that this had angered him and caused him to commit the assault.
It is learned that the French Police has handed over the American marine to the U.S. Marine Headquarters to be dealt with.

With reference to the arrest of a Korean named Tsai Ying Sing alias Lee Ming Nyoh by the French Police, Leu Yoong Mei and Zee Jih, the two lawyers retained by Tsai's family, yesterday sent the following letter to French Consul "Bah-Lee-Ong":
"Tsai Ying Sing alias Lee Ming Nyoh, a Korean, who is a naturalized Chinese citizen, was arrested at 7 a.m. March 26 at his home in Rue Pere Froo by the Lokawei Police. We have been retained by Tsai Ying Sing's wife to act for him. The other day we called on the Chief of Police but he could not give us any definite reply. In our interview with you on April 1, we were told that you had no knowledge of the case, that no warrant of arrest had been issued and that Tsai would be dealt with according to law if he was really a naturalized Chinese citizen. If such be the case, then the Police had not secured the permission of the competent official organ to arrest a Chinese citizen. This is illegal. According to the agreement relating to the establishment of a Chinese Court in the French Concession of Shanghai, a prisoner, whether or not he is suspected of any crime, should be brought before the Chinese Court for trial. Tsai Ying Sing was naturalized as a Chinese on June 13, 1925; his naturalization papers were seized by the Police at the time of his arrest. We request you to investigate this case and to order Tsai's release after examining his naturalization papers."

美军水兵被指造成一名中国人死亡。

4月1日晚9时45分，一名看似约36岁劳工模样的中国男子，在法租界姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）138号附近的人行道上由北向南行走时，一名名叫“Mi-la-da Cos-ke”（密拉特司斯克）的美军水兵严重醉酒，正与一名俄国女子沿同一方向在同一人行道上行走，该水兵用拳头击打该中国男子的面部。该男子倒地昏迷，鼻血直流。该水兵朝该男子臀部踢了最后一脚后离去。法国警察政治部华探364号張良恩（Tsang Liang Un）、一名名叫王敬五（Wong Ching Wu）的服务员，以及受雇于姐妹路134号公寓楼的285号中国更夫目睹了这一暴行。三人发出警报，几名警察赶到，将该美军水兵和俄国女子带至卢家湾警察局。伤者被送往圣玛丽医院，于当晚10时50分死亡，生前未透露身份。
昨日上午，第二特区法院检察官王任（Wong Ning）主持验尸。在听取三名证人的证词后，王检察官裁定死因为受袭击后跌倒所致伤势。
据一名证人称，被告向警察表示，死者试图触摸该俄国女子的乳房，这激怒了他并导致其实施袭击。
据悉，法国警察已将这名美军水兵移交给美国海军陆战队司令部处理。

关于法国警察逮捕一名名叫蔡英星（Tsai Ying Sing），别名李明耀（Lee Ming Nyoh）的朝鲜人一事，蔡家聘请的两名律师樓永梅（Leu Yoong Mei）和徐志（Zee Jih），昨日致函法国领事“Bah-Lee-Ong”如下：
“朝鲜人蔡英星，别名李明耀，系归化中国公民，于3月26日上午7时在其位于Pere Froo路的家中被卢家湾警察逮捕。我们受蔡英星妻子委托担任其代理人。日前我们会见警察局长，但他未能给予任何明确答复。在4月1日与阁下面谈时，阁下告知对此案不知情，并未签发逮捕令，且如果蔡确系归化中国公民，将依法处理。若情况属实，则警方在未获得主管官方机构许可的情况下逮捕中国公民。此举非法。根据关于在上海法租界设立中国法院的协定，囚犯无论是否涉嫌犯罪，均应送交中国法院审判。蔡英星于1925年6月13日归化为中国公民；其归化证书在逮捕时被警方扣押。我们请求阁下调查此案，并在查验其归化证书后下令释放蔡英星。”

issued for the arrest of Tsai Ying Sing. After being
informed of the facts in the case by the callers, the Consul
promised to make an enquiry and to accord Tsai protection if
he was really a naturalised Chinese citizen.

It is learned that the certificate of Tsai's
naturalisation was seized by the French Police at the time
of his arrest. To facilitate the negotiations, the two
lawyers have sent a telegram to the Ministry of Interior
requesting it for particulars of Tsai's naturalisation.

a protest. The lawyers have also approached the Shanghai
Bar Association for support.

ACTIVITIES OF PRO-JAPANESE AND ANTI-JAPANESE KOREANS

Following the assassination of Lee Young Ro, adviser of the Korean Residents Association, by two Koreans belonging to a Korean terrorist gang, the Japanese Consular Police keep a close watch on the activities of local Korean revolutionists residing in the French Concession and give special protection to the members of the Korean Residents Association.
The Korean Residents Association is active in promoting Korean interests and is arranging for a concert to be given at the Japanese Club at 1 p.m. March 31 for the purpose of establishing a home for unemployed Koreans in Shanghai. MILPO

SINO-JAPANESE RAPPROCHEMENT

A Rengo telegram from Tokyo dated March 30 reports that as a result of Japan's request to the Chinese Government for the suppression of the anti-Japanese movement with a view to promoting Sino-Japanese relations, the Nanking Government issued an order to all Kuomintang committees and Chambers of Commerce throughout China making the anti-Japanese boycott illegal as from March 5.
Japanese officers and civilians in China who have been instructed to keep a close watch on the effectiveness of the order, have reported to the Tokyo Foreign Office to the effect that the order up until March 29 had been well received by the Chinese and that a definite improvement could be noticed.

ARREST OF THREE JAPANESE SUBJECTS ON A CHARGE OF FRAUD

Three Japanese subjects Lee Duk Sung, age 22, S. Orio, age 23, and S. Iwasaki, age 33, were arrested by the Japanese Consular Police on a charge of fraud on the night of March 29.

SPANISH SUBJECT ARRESTED FOR INFRINGEMENT OF TRADE MARK

On March 30 the Chinese Police of a Police Station near the North Railway Station communicated with the Japanese Consular Police for assistance to search No.10 Tseng Ching Lee, Chuen Kung Road, Chapel, occupied by a person named Okumura believed to be Japanese. They claimed that the occupant was manufacturing false cigarette labels but the Japanese authorities refused to act on the ground that the occupant was not a Japanese. Subsequently the Chinese police raided the place and arrested a man named Okumura and a Chinese and seized printed matter and machinery which was being used for counterfeiting the trade marks of the "Victor Brand" cigarette. Okumura stated to the officers that he was a Spanish citizen. The two prisoners were sent to the 3rd Section of the Bureau of Public Safety.

NIPPO

KOREAN RESIDENTS ASSOCIATION TO SUPPORT THE FAMILY
OF THE LATE LEE YOUNG RO

It is reported that the Korean
Residents Association has decided to support the family
of the late Lee Young Ro, who was assassinated by two
Korean terrorists on March 25. This action is being
taken by the Association owing to the fact that Lee had
rendered valuable services to the law abiding Korean
community and had given his life for the Association.

MEETING OF JAPANESE CONSULS-GENERAL TO BE HELD IN
SHANGHAI

A Dentsu telegram from Tokyo
dated March 27 reports that the Foreign Office has decided
to call a meeting at Shanghai of Japanese Consuls-General
in China in the middle of April. All Consuls-General
will report to the meeting on the political, economical
and anti-Japanese affairs in their respective areas so
that Mr. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister to China, may gather
all necessary information to be passed to the Foreign
Office.

JAPAN TO OPPOSE CHINA'S INCREASE IN CUSTOMS DUTIES

It is reported that the Chinese
Government is contemplating increasing Customs duties on
imported goods by 20 or 25 per cent. This is regarded
as an anti-Japanese movement because such action will act as
a barrier to the importation of Japanese goods. The Chinese
Government stated that the increase was for the purpose of
giving protection to native goods but in view of the fact
that such action will be harmful to Japanese interests,
Japan will strongly oppose the measures.

MURDERER OF LEE YOUNG RO STILL IN THE HANDS OF
CHINESE AUTHORITIES

It is reported that Lee Kew Ho,
age 20, who took part in the murder of Lee Young Ro, adviser
of the Korean Residents Association, on March 25, is still in
the hands of the Chinese authorities who insist that the
prisoner claims to be a Chinese citizen and have accordingly
refused to hand him over to the Japanese authorities.

NICHI-NICHI

JAPANESE MINISTER TO CHINA LEAVES FOR NANKING

Mr. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister
to China, in company with Secretary Arino, left for
Nanking at 8 a.m. March 27. He will confer with Wang
Ching Wei, Minister of Foreign Affairs, regarding the
customs tariff and pilotage rights. He is expected to
return to Shanghai on March 29.

China Evening News and other local newspapers:
ADVISOR OF KOREAN RESIDENTS' ASSOCIATION MURDERED

On March 25, Li Yoong Lu (李容魯), advisor
of the Korean Residents' Association in Hongkew, was
murdered and the two assassins were arrested on the spot.
Nyien Hen Chen (嚴亨津), one of the murderers,
was handed over to the Japanese Consulate at 4 p.m.
March 25 by the Bureau of Public Safety. When questioned
by the Japanese Consular Police, the man declared he
was prepared to die.
The other murderer named Li Kwei Fu (李奎虎),
native of Kirin, had not yet been extradited up to the
morning of March 26. Both men are members of the Dare-
to-Die Corps of a certain Korean party.
Investigations made by the Japanese Consulate
reveal that political motives are behind this murder.
In consequence, the Japanese Consular Police are very
active. At 5 a.m. March 26, a party of the Japanese
Consular Police, with the assistance of detectives and
policemen of the French Police, raided house No. 108,
Yah Zung Li Alleyway (楊成里) on Rue de l'Observatoire
and arrested a Korean named Li Min Wong (李明王)
who was taken to the French Police Station on Route
Stanislas Chevalier.
The Japanese Consulate demanded that Li Min
Wong be handed over immediately, but the French Consul
refused to extradite the accused on the ground that he
had no connection with the recent murder case.

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of Gen. Chiang Kai Shek)
and other local newspapers:

THE DEATH OF A FEMALE VEGETABLE HAWKER

vegetable hawker named Chao Liu Chia Lee is alleged to
have been assaulted to death by foreign policeman No. 62
of Pootoo Road Police Station, representatives of the
various Branches of the 1st Special District Citizens
Federation held a special meeting on March 21 at the
office of the 4th Branch in the Western District, at
which it was resolved to form a Committee to Support
the Case and to request the Chinese Authorities to open
negotiations with the S.M.C.
The Committee will hold a meeting with various
local public bodies at 3 p.m. March 28 at the office of
the 1st Special District Citizens Federation in the
Temple of Queen of Heaven, North Honan Road.

ARRIVAL OF HUPEH REFUGEES

Recently some 80 refugees from drought affected
areas in Hupeh Province arrived at Ningpo. They left
by water on March 25 and arrived at the Nantao Fund at

the refugees proceeded to the San Kwan Daung (三官堂)
at Boh Kya Pang (卜家浜), Nantao, where they are being

《中国晚报》及其他本地报纸：
朝鲜人居住会顾问被杀

3月25日，虹口朝鲜人居住会顾问李容鲁（Li Yoong Lu）遇刺身亡，两名刺客当场被捕。其中一名刺客严亨津（Nyien Hen Chen）于3月25日下午4时由公安局移交日本领事馆。在接受日本领事警察讯问时，该男子声称已做好赴死准备。
另一名刺客名为李奎虎（Li Kwei Fu），吉林人，截至3月26日上午尚未被引渡。两人均系某朝鲜政党敢死队成员。
日本领事馆的调查表明，这起谋杀案背后有政治动机。因此，日本领事警察行动积极。3月26日凌晨5时，一队日本领事警察在法国巡捕的侦探和警员协助下，突袭了位于天文台路（Rue de l'Observatoire）杨成里（Yah Zung Li Alleyway）108号的住所，逮捕了一名名叫李明王（Li Min Wong）的朝鲜人，并将其带往司各脱路（Route Stanislas Chevalier）的法国巡捕房。
日本领事馆要求立即移交李明王，但法国领事以该嫌疑人与最近的谋杀案无关为由，拒绝引渡被告。

该委员会将于3月28日下午3时，在北河南路天后宫的第一特区市民联合会办事处，与各地方公共团体举行会议。

湖北难民抵沪

of the Bureau of Public Safety on duty in the vicinity

foreign dress, running away. The officers gave chase
and arrested one of them at the entrance of Lane No.925,
while the other was captured near the Che Shing Market
(齊盛市場). The two men were taken to the Police
Station on North Szechuen Road. Two pistols bearing
the numbers 421107 and 9657 were found in their
possession. After being interrogated, they were
transferred to the Bureau of Public Safety to be dealt
with.
The three wounded Koreans were removed to
the Foo Ming Hospital but Li Yoong Lu succumbed at
about noon. The lives of the other two persons are
not in danger.
It is believed that political motives are
behind this murder. A similar affair occurred last
year in Lai Sing Li (萊心里) near yesterday's shooting.
The victim in that affair was a Korean named Liu Ying
Fah (柳英發) who was only wounded.

Shanghai City Government notified all private and public
schools in the city that an anti-spitting movement
will be held under the auspices of the Public Bodies
Anti-Spitting Movement Committee. The campaign against

《华中日报》（汪精卫的官方喉舌）：

朝鲜人居住会主席被杀

朝鲜人李容鲁（Li Yoong Lu），37岁，与其妻子杜成星（Doo Sung Sing）及内弟杜宗鲁（Doo Zoong Roh）居住在狄思威路（界外道路）裕新里925弄16号二楼。
近期李容鲁被任命为朝鲜人居住会主席。他被怀疑亲日。
昨日上午7时40分，当李容鲁尚在床上时，两名年轻朝鲜人进入其房间并向他开枪。五发子弹击中其头部及身体其他部位。其妻子和内弟试图阻止这两名男子，但也遭到枪击受伤。
听到枪声后，附近执勤的公安局警员迅速赶到现场，看见两名身穿西式服装的男子正在逃跑。警员展开追捕，在925弄口逮捕了其中一人，另一人则在齐盛市场（Che Shing Market）附近被抓获。两人被带往北四川路巡捕房。在他们身上搜出两把手枪，编号分别为421107和9657。经讯问后，他们被移交给公安局处理。
三名受伤的朝鲜人被送往福明医院，但李容鲁于中午左右伤重不治。另外两人的生命暂无危险。
据信这起谋杀案背后有政治动机。去年在距昨日枪击地点不远的莱心里（Lai Sing Li）发生过类似事件。该事件的受害者是一名名叫柳英发（Liu Ying Fah）的朝鲜人，仅受轻伤。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

禁吐痰运动

昨日，上海市政府教育局通知全市所有私立和公立学校，将在公共团体禁吐痰运动委员会的主持下开展禁吐痰运动。禁吐痰宣传活动将从3月28日持续至31日。第一天为学生日，随后依次为工人日、商人日和公共团体日。

March 26, 1935. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

NIPPO

ADVISER OF THE KOREAN RESIDENTS ASSOCIATION ASSASSINATED

At 7.40 a.m. March 25 two armed Koreans entered No. 17 Yue Shing Li, Dixwell Road, occupied by Lee Young Ro, adviser of the Korean Residents Association, and fired several shots at Mr. Lee who was in bed. Awakened by the firing, Mrs. Lee grappled with the assassin but she was shot in the head and hand. A Korean servant named Pak Soong Bok, age 18, rushed to the scene but was struck on the head with the butt of the pistol.

A Chinese constable of Lin Ping Road Station of the Bureau of Public Safety rushed to the house and succeeded in arresting one of the assassins. The other was captured on Dixwell Road by a Chinese constable of the Bureau of Public Safety on North Szochuen Road.

The wounded Koreans were immediately removed to the Foo Ming Hospital but Lee Young Ro succumbed to his injuries at 12.30 p.m. The condition of Mrs. Lee and the Korean servant is not serious.

Later, a party of Japanese Consular Police visited the scene of assassination and conducted an investigation. The Korean detained at the Lin Ping Road Police Station gave his name as Aum Hyung Soon, age 30, residing at No. 12 Rue du Marche, French Concession, while the man detained at the Chinese police station on North Szechuen Road gave his name as Lee Kew Ho, age 20. The two prisoners have been transferred to the Bureau of Public Safety. Both are believed to be revolutionists.

The Korean Residents Association will make arrangements for the funeral of the murdered man because he had rendered valuable service to the Association. The deceased leaves a widow and 4 children. One of his daughters is attending the Japanese Girls High School, while a son, 11 years of age, is in the Japanese school on North Szechuen Road.

The prisoner Aum Hyung Soon was handed over to the Japanese authorities by the Chinese authorities at 3 p.m. March 25. The other prisoner named Lee Kew Ho is reported to be still in the hands of the Chinese authorities because he claims to be a native of Kirin Province.

An urgent meeting of the Korean Residents Association was called yesterday by Mr. Lee Kab Nyung, President of the Association, at the Japanese Y.M.C.A. to discuss the assassination of Mr. Lee Young Ro.

Later about 40 Koreans assembled at the Japanese Y.M.C.A. on Range Road and resolved to present a demand to the Chinese police authorities for the handing over of the prisoner to the Japanese Consular authorities or to them.

At about 5 p.m. as the representatives of the Association were about to proceed to the Bureau of Public Safety to submit their demand they were stopped by the Japanese authorities.

杂项

《日日新闻》

朝鲜人居住会顾问遇刺

3月25日上午7时40分，两名武装朝鲜人进入狄思威路悦盛里17号，该处由朝鲜人居住会顾问李容鲁（Lee Young Ro）居住，并向躺在床上的李先生开了数枪。李太太被枪声惊醒，与刺客搏斗，但头部和手部中弹。一名名叫朴成福（Pak Soong Bok，音译）、18岁的朝鲜仆役冲到现场，但被用手枪枪托击中头部。

公安局临平路巡捕房的一名华捕迅速赶到该住所，成功逮捕了其中一名刺客。另一名刺客在狄思威路上被北四川路公安局的一名华捕抓获。

受伤的朝鲜人立即被送往福明医院，但李容鲁于下午12时30分伤重不治。李太太和朝鲜仆役的伤势不严重。

随后，一队日本领事警察参观了刺杀现场并进行了调查。被拘押在临平路巡捕房的朝鲜人自称安亨顺（Aum Hyung Soon，音译），30岁，住在法租界马浪路（Rue du Marche）12号；而被拘押在北四川路中国巡捕房的男子自称李奎浩（Lee Kew Ho，音译），20岁。两名囚犯已被移交给公安局。两人均被认为是革命党人。

朝鲜人居住会将安排死者的葬礼，因为他曾为该会做出宝贵贡献。死者遗孀及四名子女。其中一个女儿就读于日本女子高等中学，一个11岁的儿子在北四川路的日本学校读书。

囚犯安亨顺于3月25日下午3时由中国当局移交给日本当局。据报道，另一名名为李奎浩的囚犯仍掌握在中国当局手中，因为他声称是吉林省人。

昨日，朝鲜人居住会会长李甲宁（Lee Kab Nyung，音译）先生在日本青年会召开紧急会议，讨论李容鲁先生被刺一案。

随后，约40名朝鲜人在兰路（Range Road）的日本青年会集会，决议向中国警察当局提出要求，将囚犯移交给日本领事当局或移交给他们。

下午5时许，当该会代表正准备前往公安局提交要求时，被日本当局拦阻。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. D
Date March 25, 1935.

Subject Murder of Ri Yoh Ro (李容盧), former Vice-Chairman of the local
Korean Association.
Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by

At about 7 a.m. march 25, a Korean called at the
residence of another Korean named Ri Yoh Ro, on the 2nd floor
of No. 16 Yue Shing Li, off Dixwell Road, O.O.L., and stated
that he had come from Nanking to see one, Kim Oh Chin (金應鎭),
Treasurer of the newly organized Korean Residents' Association,
who is living in the adjoining room on the same floor. The
message was conveyed to Kim Oh Chin but he refused to receive
the visitor. At this time the visitor suddenly produced a
pistol and fired a shot at Ri Yoh Ro, who was asleep on a bed
situated near the entrance to the room, wounding him in the head.
Boku Sei Shin (朴聖信), wife of Ri Yoh Ro, 37, Korean, with
the assistance of Boku Shu Fuku (朴崇福), 18, Korean servant
employed at the Korean Residents' Association, attempted to
arrest the assailant, but he fired several shots at the two,
wounding Boku Sei Shin on the back of the head and on the left
hand. Boku Shu Fuku received cuts on his head and cheek, being
struck with the butt of the pistol during the struggle.

In the meantime, a number of officers of the Public
Safety Bureau arrived on the scene and arrested the Korean
just as he was decamping from the premises. He gave his name
as Gen Kyo Shun (嚴亨淳), 30, Korean. Another accomplice
who was keeping a watch in front of the premises was arrested
by officers of the Public Safety Bureau at the corner of
Mah Ka Lee Terrace and East Dixwell Road, O.O.L. This
individual gave his name as Li Kei Ko (李奎虎), 20, and
claimed to be a native of Kirin Province. The two persons
are at present detained at the Headquarters of the Public
Safety Bureau, Nantao.

日期 1935年3月25日。

事由 前朝鲜协会副主席李容盧（Ri Yoh Ro）被杀案。
制作人 D. S. Umemoto. 转呈人

3月25日上午7时许，一名朝鲜人来到老闸捕房辖区狄思威路（Dixwell Road）旁越盛里16号二楼，拜访另一名朝鲜人李容盧（Ri Yoh Ro），并称其从南京来，欲见住在同层隔壁房间的新组建朝鲜居民联合会司库金应镇（Kim Oh Chin）。消息传达给金应镇后，他拒绝接见来访者。此时，来访者突然掏出手枪，向睡在房间入口附近床上的李容卢开了一枪，击中其头部致其受伤。李容卢之妻，37岁朝鲜人朴圣信（Boku Sei Shin），在朝鲜居民联合会雇佣的18岁朝鲜仆人朴崇福（Boku Shu Fuku）协助下，试图逮捕袭击者，但袭击者向两人连开数枪，击中朴圣信后脑及左手。朴崇福在搏斗中被枪托击中，头部和脸颊受伤。

与此同时，多名公安局警官抵达现场，在该朝鲜人正欲逃离 premises 时将其逮捕。他自称严亨淳（Gen Kyo Shun），30岁，朝鲜人。另一名在屋前望风的同伙，在老闸捕房辖区马嘉利台（Mah Ka Lee Terrace）与东狄思威路转角处被公安局警官逮捕。此人自称李奎虎（Li Kei Ko），20岁，声称籍贯为吉林省。目前两人均被羁押于南市公安局总部。

三名伤者被送往福民

Negotiations have been opened between the local Japanese Consular Authorities and the Bureau of Public Safety for the extradition of the Korean assassin.
